title: S85 later notes: pager-style page keys, help overlay, group keys on Roadmap and Waves

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Later notes from the S85 relay (run-20261026-153110-0f43, landed 3672a6a), not fixed in that slice.
Owner decision (2026-10-26, session a2bf7e0e, interactive question): page keys become pager style, like less ctrl-f. pgdown scrolls the window so the first unseen row is at the top and puts the cursor on it; pgup is the mirror. Today pgdown moves by the rows drawn and, from the window's bottom edge, skips up to a page of unseen rows.
Other notes:
- With the help overlay open, page keys and j/k still move the hidden cursor; return early in moveRows when help shows.
- No page-key test for a Ready row with cut command lines (mutation P5 survives).
- The trailing "Ready to land / none" lines on an overflowing Overview can never be scrolled into view; G stops on the last Recent row (probably predates S85).
- Help says "scroll a pane", but the Roadmap item pane does not page-scroll (predates S85).
- The selected project's number is hidden by the > arrow; show it somewhere (owner kept the arrow).
- { and } do nothing on Roadmap and Waves; decide their section mapping.
- The help overlay is cut at 80x24, with q and esc below the fold (may fold into S149).
- The S111 and S118 digit keys are not newly tested against the new number keys (the pane takes them first).
- pageRows renders the screen about 15 times per page key (about 12 ms); pager style may make this unnecessary.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/model.go` (moveRows, pageRows), `internal/tui/view.go` (drawn rows, window start).
- `internal/tui/roadmap.go`, `internal/tui/waves.go`, `internal/tui/view.go` (help overlay).
- Tests: `internal/tui/tui_test.go`.
- `docs/dashboard.md`: the page key paragraph.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first: TestPgDownShowsTheFirstUnseenRowAtTheTop and its pgup mirror, at 80x24 and 100x30.
2. Pager-style page keys on the Overview, Questions and Decisions; an open pane still takes them first.
3. Triage the other notes; spec each kept one with a failing test.
UI slice: UI pass per rule u10.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
